text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu brilliantly claims victory. 
The Umamusume who had given up chasing her 
felt a renewed surge of frustration and 
awe at her flawless strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there is no way Symboli Rudolf 
could overlook her remarkable performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the "Takarazuka Kinen," 
where titans from all distances gather. 
Running flawlessly amidst fierce rivals, 
she will prove her legs are second to 
none—!
